description: This file defines configuration for the Eclipse Kura protocol adapter in a Spring Boot application, including bean setups, metrics, and customization methods.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring configuration class setting up beans, metrics, and adapter properties for the Kura protocol adapter.

methods.name: kuraProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of KuraProtocolAdapter with prototype scope.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides to set default name if not provided in ClientConfigProperties for downstream sender.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides to set default name if not provided in RequestResponseClientConfigProperties for registration client.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides to set default name if not provided in RequestResponseClientConfigProperties for credentials client.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides to set default name if not provided in RequestResponseClientConfigProperties for tenant client.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Creates a bean of KuraAdapterProperties with prefix 'hono.kura' for binding configuration properties.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures the meter registry to include common tags for protocol adapter type.

methods.name: adapterMetrics
methods.description: Creates a new MicrometerBasedMqttAdapterMetrics instance for metrics collection.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Provides a factory bean for creating instances of KuraProtocolAdapter.
